title: linum hirsutum subsp. platyphyllum
intro: Linum hirsutum subsp. platyphyllum, commonly known as Great Prickly Thistle, is a plant species in the Linaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety, making it a potential remedy for insomnia and stress relief. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Linum hirsutum subsp. platyphyllum include its potential to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of menopause due to its estrogenic properties.
